entries: Then {first} saw {the_someone} had acted out of {MOTIVE}, which no machine could fake.
Then {first} decoded the rest of {the_message}: it asked only for {VALUE}.
Then {first} saw the {rival:human} was lonely too, and also wanted {want}.
Then {first} ran the numbers and chose {need} over {want}.
Then {first} grasped that {MOTIVE} was what made them human, not {want}.
